snippet.title: LEGO® NEXO KNIGHTS™ Merlok Power – The Merlok of Merlok
snippet.description:
2025 IS NEXO KNIGHTS YEAR!

Clay is the most powerful NEXO KNIGHTS™ Hero in the kingdom, but even he needs to increase his power to defeat evil! When Clay needs extra strength on the battlefield, he summons The Merlok of Merlok. This Merlok Power causes a lightning bolt to strike in the center of the battlefield, stunning enemies, and periodically generates magical fire that burns enemies. As the icing on the cake, Merlok appears to aid the knight in battle!
